title: NFL Football
description:
New England Patriots vs. Detroit Lions
The Detroit Lions face the New England Patriots in an NFL regular-season game at Allianz Arena in Munich, Germany. Detroit arrives at 6-2 on a four-game winning streak, while New England enters at 5-4 after a 45-27 home loss to the Green Bay Packers.

title: NFL Football
description:
Minnesota Vikings at Green Bay Packers
The Green Bay Packers host the Minnesota Vikings in an NFC North rivalry game at Lambeau Field. Minnesota has won four of the last five meetings, including a 39-22 win at U.S. Bank Stadium earlier this season, and Green Bay looks to even the series.

title: NFL Football
